emma: Quick sync on SDK snippet updates: i opened 3 small PRs for streaming/pagination/retry. looking for fast reviews.
noah: drop PR ids?
emma: #4301 (py streaming example), #4302 (ts pagination minor rename), #4303 (go retry example).
lint-bot: note: docs smoke tests run on py3.10/node16/go1.20; code blocks must be runnable.
ravi: i pasted a minimal canonical snippet to reference in all PRs to avoid drift. please keep them under docs/snippets/canonical.
noah: paste it here so i can eyeball quickly.
ravi: python compact:
```py
# compat: SDK >= v0.10.0
for ev in Client().responses.stream(model="chat-1", input="Summarize"):
  if ev.type == 'token': print(ev.text, end='')
```
noah: fine. for TS just ensure `for await` is used.
emma: decision: merge #4302 and #4303 after lint fixes. hold #4301 until deploy finishes tomorrow since it touches the streaming iterator shape.
ravi: i'll add a one-line smoke script to each PR and a compat note.
lint-bot: deploy window: runtime v1.14 -> v1.15 at 2026-03-22T02:00:00Z. if your snippet depends on the new streaming contract, add `hold: true`.
emma: thanks, will add holds where needed and update PR descriptions. closing thread.
